name: Cart subtotal keeps the cents
description: Three Speckled Mugs at $18.50 must total exactly $55.50.

planSteps.description: On the shop page, click the "Add to cart" button for Speckled Mug three times
Click the Cart link in the store header
The cart line for Speckled Mug shows quantity 3
The Subtotal row in the order summary reads exactly $55.50
The Shipping row reads Free and the Total row reads exactly $55.50
